### Added

- *(model-serving)* A preset's spec.split.env for a split only in [#774](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/774) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)

### Changed

- *(deps)* Update gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/kubectl docker tag to v1.37.1 in [#656](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/656) by [@renovate[bot]](https://github.com/renovate[bot])
- Align files according to platform standards in [#777](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/777) by [@giantswarm-align-files[bot]](https://github.com/giantswarm-align-files[bot])
- *(make)* Verify recipes write scratch renders under TMPDIR and render with the HELM binary in [#778](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/778) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho)

### Fixed

- *(kagent)* The migrate Job reads no GitHub token in [#776](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/776) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(connectivity)* A network policy for the hook Jobs' identity in [#779](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/779) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
- *(connectivity)* Start the migrate run from a CronJob after its policy in [#781](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/781) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
